verdict.rationale: xAI docs provide per-request cost visibility (cost_in_usd_ticks), prepaid credit balance monitoring via the Management API, rate limits tied to spend tiers, and per-model pricing tables — giving founders tools to track and understand spend. However, there is no documented feature for setting a hard spending cap, budget threshold, or proactive usage alert/notification that stops or warns before a bill grows; the mechanism relies on prepaid credits running out or hitting rate limits rather than explicit configurable spend caps/alerts. missing for 10: a documented spend-cap/budget-limit setting, configurable usage alerts/notifications, and evidence of automatic throttling or shutoff tied to a founder-set dollar threshold.
